text:
Sara (marketing): Quick check — for Thursday's webinar I want to A/B the reg page and split post-event clips into 3 short assets. Can ops confirm Zoom settings + recording split workflow?
Ajay (growth): yes pls. split into: highlight (60s), demo clip (90s), deep-dive (3m). We should tag leads by which clip they watch.
Natalie (events): Zoom settings: cloud recording + separate audio file. I'll enable "record active speaker" + "record gallery". Are we ok with automatic transcript?
Maria (ops): ok on settings. Need Zoom cloud + recording auto-delete = off. Also make sure we have consent on registration checkbox for recording permission.
Sara (marketing): For registration we want two variants: Variant A = short form + UTM campaign=webinar_nov; Variant B = longer form with 2 questions (team size, priority use-case). We'll route B leads to SDR.
Ajay (growth): routing: we should map fields into HubSpot and add a custom property 'webinar_variant' and 'clip_interest'. Also push 'intent_score' when they watch clip.
Natalie (events): timeline: live ends 12:30pm -> recording available ~12:50pm -> clips ready ~2pm. Need editor to trim and upload to Wistia and create CTAs on zoom replay.
Maria (ops): I'll add Zap to move new registrants into HubSpot and tag variant. Draft of Zapier field mapping:
```
Trigger: New Registrant (Typeform/HubSpot)
Actions:
 - Create/Update Contact in HubSpot
 - Set property: webinar_variant = {{form.variant}}
 - Add note: registration_source = {{utm_source}}
 - Add to list: webinar_nov_registrants
```
Sara (marketing): Perfect. For follow-up cadence: immediate thank-you email with replay in 1hr, clip drip at 24h (highlight), 72h (demo), 7d (deep-dive). Also run a remarketing ad to viewers of highlight for 2 weeks.
Ajay (growth): Can we add an endpoint that pings our event-tracking service when a clip is viewed? Simple webhook -> attach segment event "webinar_clip_view" with clip_id and contact email.
Maria (ops): Yup I can create webhook. Also adding ZoomBot to notify: when cloud recording processed, post link to #marketing and add reaction :eyes: 
ZoomBot: Cloud recording processed: https://zoom.us/recording/abcd1234 — transcript ready. :white_check_mark:
Natalie (events): @Sara pls confirm who does the edit and QA. We have VidTeam on standby but need final approval window.
Sara (marketing): I'll handle QA for highlight + demo. Ajay will review deep-dive. Natalie -> schedule editor for 1-3pm slot.
Ajay (growth): Also reminder to include closed captions on clips and captions file to Wistia for SEO.
Maria (ops): All set — zap and webhook scheduled. I'll post final runbook in #marketing tomorrow morning. :rocket:
